quests.title: Above the Clouds
quests.description: Beyond a fallen mountain pass north of the coast lie the Frostbloom Highlands, and an old shrine to the aurora.

steps.text: Read the climber's note near the fallen pass
Make a Climbing Rope at the cottage workbench
Climb up to the Frostbloom Highlands

hints: The climbing rope is braided twine sealed with resin. The rope is a tool: you keep it.
